content.text:
I wrote "Answer: Business & Finance is less common than Family & Relationships" to `/work/answer.txt`. It is an estimate, not an exact count.

The file in `/work/context.txt` has no labels, only the question text. I classified the questions with keyword matching instead of reading and labelling each one.

- **Business & Finance keywords:** about 34 of 413 questions matched.
- **Family & Relationships keywords:** about 56 of 413 questions matched.

The gap is large enough that I expect the direction to be right. The keyword lists were rough, though, so the exact counts could be off. Also, I found 413 question lines even though the file's header says 414.
